Eat it to recover hearts.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== Roasted Bird Thighs are a type of [[Roasted Food]], and they are the result of [[Raw Bird Thigh]]s that have made contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} [[Black Hinox]]es can also drop them upon their deaths. Roasted Bird Thighs are said to have crisp skin and juicy meat inside. [[Link]] can restore two and a quarter [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]] by eating a [[Roasted Bird Thigh]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Frozen Bird Thigh * Raw Bird Thigh * Roasted Bird Drumstick * Roasted Food * Roasted Whole Bird }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meats, Roasted Food |items= BotW }}
